name: DeepRetinotopy
summary: DeepRetinotopy brainlife.io app: predict retinotopic maps from cortical anatomy using geometric deep learning. Based on the original deepRetinotopy model by Fernanda L. Ribeiro et al. (2021, 2024, 2025).

parameters.description: Comma-separated maps to predict: polarAngle, eccentricity, pRFsize
Dataset label passed to the deepRetinotopy toolbox
Internal subject id used when staging the FreeSurfer input
Fast midthickness generation: yes or no
Pass --nv to Singularity for GPU-accelerated inference
vnmd/deepretinotopy container tag to pull (default: 1.0.18; use 1.0.19 if your resource has Apptainer >= 1.5.3)
Fold polar angle from 0-360° to 0-180° (Benson/neuropythy convention; hemisphere encodes left vs right visual field)
Use NaN-aware barycentric interpolation for surface-to-volume projection (non-finite vertices get zero weight; disable if results look worse than standard prism projection)
